helpContextMenuDesc1.message: Due to API limitations, a unified toggle command for the side panel is not available, so it is split into two separate menu commands: Open Side Panel and Close Side Panel.

helpContextMenuDesc2.message: After clicking a context menu option that sends content to the side panel, you need to open the side panel manually to view it. **On unsupported pages, context menu options for sending to the side panel, new window, or new incognito tab may be unavailable.**

helpIncognitoDesc1.message: Without the **Allow in incognito** option enabled, whether triggered from the side panel or the context menu, the extension will always open content in a newly created incognito window. Therefore, to ensure it opens in an existing incognito window, please enable **Allow in incognito** in chrome://extensions for this extension.

helpIncognitoDesc2.message: When **Allow in incognito** is enabled, after clicking the **Open in new incognito tab** button or selecting **Send Selected Text To New Incognito Tab** from the context menu, you may notice that the existing incognito window does not immediately come to the foreground. This is expected behavior, as new incognito tab has already been opened in the background. Please check all open browser windows.

helpIncognitoNote.message: You need to enable the **Enable Incognito Features** option in Settings to use incognito-related features.

helpSearchEngineDesc.message: By default, the browser's configured default search engine is used. You can temporarily enable the **Enable The Custom Search Engine Temporarily** option in the side panel settings to choose a preferred engine; this setting only applies to the current side panel session and resets when the side panel is closed. Due to API limitations, the context menu option **Send Selected Text To New Incognito Tab** always uses Google search.

helpSettingsDesc.message: You can manage features by category in the side panel settings: enable incognito and new-window opening, customize context menu items, configure text staging and the search engine, and reset all settings.
